name: TextInput
summary: A single text-like value: text, number, email, phone, currency, search or long text.

help.description: Hint shown below the label (not a placeholder)

message.description: Error message shown when validation fails

placeholder.description: Only for kind 'search', shown inside the field. Never a substitute for the label.

size.description: 'hero' for the one number a surface is about (an amount to send): large and centred

whenNotToUse: A value from a known set: use Choice
Secrets (passwords, card numbers): not generated; hosts provide their own secure flows

requirements: Help and errors are associated with the field
Kind sets the right keyboard and autocomplete

rendering: Errors appear after the user leaves the field or submits, not while typing
kind 'search' renders as a pill search field with an icon; the label stays as its accessible name
size 'hero' renders a large centred amount with the currency symbol dimmed

mappings.web: shadcn Input / Textarea with Label and FormMessage

sources: GOV.UK text input and question pages
